hero.name: Field Repository
hero.tagline: Living craft documentation: artisans, crafts, workshops and interviews captured in the field, transcribed into English and kept as a research-ready dataset.
hero.label: Field Repository: living craft documentation, captured in the field, transcribed into English and kept as a research-ready dataset

cards.label: What the Field Repository does: capture, offline, interviews, transcripts, review and the dataset

items.title: Eight linked record types
items.body: Artisans, crafts, workshops, products, tools, processes, interviews and media, linked from the moment they are saved.

items.title: Works without signal
items.body: The Android app saves to an outbox, keeps takes on the phone and syncs with idempotency keys when a network returns.

items.title: One questionnaire engine
items.body: Sessions, takes, coverage and canonical answers from one shared engine, with chips and filters on every recording.

items.title: Every voice in English
items.body: Scribe v3 hears the words, Gemini 3.8 Flash translates each turn, and the viewer follows the audio word by word.

items.title: Six-tier ladder
items.body: Each tier reviews the one below: approve, reject or send back, and every decision is kept.

items.title: Browse it, export it
items.body: A data browser laid out as folders, report workbooks, transcripts in every export, and a streaming dataset API.

cards:ai.label: The AI in the Field Repository: transcription, translation, Ask, autodraft, quote cards, consent and budget

items.title: Scribe v3 words
items.body: Speakers, timings and key terms from the artisan, the craft and the master list. Video is heard from its sound.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.body: English for every turn, a summary and key quotes in one pass, with 3.7 Flash as the fallback.

items.title: Questions, cited
items.body: Ask one transcript a question and get an answer that points back to the turns it came from.

items.title: Drafts, not answers
items.body: Open questionnaire questions drafted from a take; a person accepts each one before it counts.

items.title: Their words, shared
items.body: An image and audio clip of a quote, refused the moment the artisan withdraws consent.

items.title: Consent and budget
items.body: Consent re-read before every send, a monthly budget per portal, and a 15-minute hold on a 402.

cards:ops.label: How the Field Repository is run: blue/green releases, backups, origin lock, two-step sign-in, RLS and comment-free code

items.title: Blue / green
items.body: Two loopback ports behind nginx. The idle one starts, answers /health, and only then takes traffic.

items.title: Nightly, checked
items.body: pg_dump to S3 every night, a weekly copy kept for a year, and a freshness check that fails loudly.

items.title: CloudFront only
items.body: The box answers CloudFront alone; SSH opens for one runner during a deploy and closes after.

items.title: Two-step, roster
items.body: TOTP with recovery codes, an access roster at the door, and six roles enforced on the server.

items.title: RLS everywhere
items.body: Row Level Security on every table and the anon role revoked; Aadhaar kept only as a fingerprint.

items.title: No comments
items.body: A CI job fails on any comment in code; the reasons live in the docs, beside the rules they explain.
